info.title: processd — process decisions
info.description: Answers the published Entscheidungsbäume for NB, LF and MSB, queues what it cannot decide for an operator, starts and ends supply on the LF's behalf, and keeps the process read model. Every refusal answers with `ApiError`; branch on `code`.

get.description:
Per-PID evidence for the **Gleichbehandlungsbericht** a vertically
integrated undertaking's Gleichbehandlungsbeauftragte files with the
Bundesnetzagentur by **31 March** for the preceding calendar year
(§ 7a Abs. 5 EnWG), and publishes in non-personalised form.
Lieferantenwechsel is one of the areas those reports examine.

It compares how the operator's network arm treated Lieferanten inside its
own undertaking against third-party Lieferanten, over the processes the
network arm actually answers (`handler::is_nb_answered_lieferanten_process`).
The underlying duties are § 6a EnWG (informatorische Entflechtung) and
§ 20 Abs. 1 Satz 1 EnWG (diskriminierungsfreier Netzzugang).

**`gap_pp` is `affiliate − third_party`, in percentage points.** A positive
gap means the affiliate fared better, which is the concern. This convention
is `ParityComparison`'s and is shared with the `de.mako.obs.stp.parity.alert`
CloudEvent and the MCP tool: three surfaces read one sign, because a sign
computed per surface is a sign that can disagree about which side was
favoured.

**No threshold is asserted.** The Bundesnetzagentur publishes no numeric
parity limit for this figure; what counts as a gap worth explaining is the
operator's judgement, and the escalation threshold lives in
`[obs] parity_threshold_pp`. A gap over a group smaller than
`PARITY_MIN_SAMPLE` is reported as `null`, not as a large number.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The calendar year; the current Berlin year when absent

200.description: The § 7a Abs. 5 EnWG Gleichbehandlung report, per PID affiliate against third party

`POST /api/v1/klaerfaelle/{id}/assign` — take the case, or release it;
journaled against the authenticated principal.

404.description: No such case the caller may read

post.description:
Sends the case's correcting command ([`crate::klaerfall::korrektur`])
through the Freigabe decision path: a pending Freigabe is decided by the
approve/reject route itself; an answer the counterparty refused is
re-sent from the decided Freigabe with the same checks —
`decision_body`, the code against the tree, the body shown, and makod's
pre-send check, whose refusal comes back in place. Another command than
the proposal needs a `begruendung`; a command outside the Freigabe's
approve/reject pair is refused. The caller needs `dispatch-case` and the
command's own authority — `decide-queue` in the Marktrolle the Freigabe
owes the answer as. The proposal, the command sent and the reason are
journaled against the authenticated principal.

200.description: The case after the correcting command went out

404.description: No such case the caller may read

409.description: `case_closed`

422.description: A refusal naming the rule that decided (`no_correction`, makod's pre-send check)

post.summary: Approve an approval-queue entry: claim it, then dispatch its command.
post.description:
A held Accept is dispatched with the answer frozen when it was queued;
an escalated entry needs the operator's answer in the body
(`OperatorAnswer`: `antwort_code`, `antwort_tree`, `antwort_codeliste`,
`bemerkung`) and is refused with `422` without the fields its command
needs.

`expires_at` carries the *business* answer Frist of the queued process,
read from `mako_fristen::antwort`, less an hour of headroom. Operators
must act before it.

post.description:

Steuerungsauftrag, the MaLo of the row) comes from the entry.

put.description:
Attach the executing system's reference to an order — the way an order
that arrived from the market gets one. Every later `de.mako.sperr.*` event of
the order echoes it, and `GET /api/v1/sperr-orders?external_ref=` finds it.

409.description: `external_ref_taken`: another order carries it

put.description:
A Sperrversuch that did not succeed.

The **first** one is recorded and the order stays in the queue: GPKE Teil 2
Kap. 3.5.1.2 Nr. 5 gives the NB two Sperrversuche within one Sperrauftrag, and
answering `Z13 gescheitert` after one visit ends a process that still owes a
second. The second attempt — or `endgueltig: true` for a legal or factual
impossibility — closes the order and dispatches IFTSTA 21039 so the Lieferant
learns *why* instead of waiting out their window.

202.description: Recorded; its IFTSTA 21039 is queued, or the order stays open for a second Sperrversuch

204.description: Recorded; an operator-created order owes no IFTSTA

409.description: `order_not_pending`: executed, failed or withdrawn; carries `status` and `executed_at`

422.description: An empty `reason`

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/start-supply` — ERP initiates a GPKE Lieferbeginn (Strom SLP).
post.description:
Validates the LFW24 Mindestvorlauffrist and dispatches
`gpke.lieferbeginn.anmelden` to `makod`.

## Request body (JSON)

| Field               | Type   | Required | Notes |
|---------------------|--------|----------|-------|
| `malo_id`           | string | ✓        | 11-digit Strom Marktlokations-ID |
| `lieferbeginn_datum` | string | ✓        | ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `transaktionsgrund` | string | ✓        | `SG4 STS+7` DE 9013, `E01` Ein-/Auszug (Umzug) or `E03` Wechsel — the column makes it Muss (UTILMD AHB Strom 2.2 Kap. 8.2, S. 73). The Strom date rule is identical for both (LFW24) |
| `bilanzkreis`       | string | —        | `SG8 SEQ+Z79`; without it the single `standard` entry of `[[lf.bilanzkreise]]` |
| `haushaltskunde`    | bool   | ✓        | `SG8 SEQ+Z01 SG10 CCI+++Z15`/`Z18` (S. 83) |
| `enfg_grundlage`    | string | ✓        | `SG8 SEQ+Z75 CCI+Z61` — `ZF9`, `ZG0`, `ZG1` (S. 85) |
| `enfg_grund`        | string | with `ZF9` | `SG10 CAV` — `ZU5` … `ZV3` |
| `kunde`             | object | ✓        | `SG12 NAD+Z09`/`Z04` — name and Korrespondenzanschrift (S. 86) |

A missing Kunde fact is `ANMELDEDATEN_UNVOLLSTAENDIG`, one the column
cannot carry `ANMELDEDATEN_UNGUELTIG`.

## LFW24 Vorlauffrist (BK6-22-024, consolidated in BK6-24-174 GPKE Teil 2)

SD "Lieferbeginn" Prozessschritt 1: "Unverzüglich nach Vorliegen des
Anmeldegrundes, jedoch **spätester ÜT ist der Tag vor dem letzten WT vor
dem Zuordnungsbeginn**." The Frist is day-granular (ÜT = calendar day of
the AS4 receipt) — there is **no time-of-day cutoff**.

- Earliest Lieferbeginn for a submission today: the calendar day **after
  the next Werktag** after today (Berlin date).
- Retroactive dates (`lieferbeginn_datum` < today Berlin) are always rejected.

409.description: makod refused the command in the process's state

422.description: A refusal naming the rule that decided (`MISSING_MALO_ID`, `ANMELDEDATEN_UNVOLLSTAENDIG`, …)

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/start-supply-gas` — ERP initiates a GeLi Gas Lieferbeginn (Gas 44001).
post.description:
Dispatches `geli.lieferbeginn.anmelden` to `makod` with the body
[`mako_markt::commands::GeliLieferbeginnAnmelden`].

## Request body (JSON) — [`StartSupplyGasRequest`]

| Field | Required | Segment (UTILMD AHB Gas 1.2 Kap. 5.6) |
|---|---|---|
| `malo_id` | ✓ | `SG5 LOC+172` under `IMD++Z36+Z12` |
| `process_date` | ✓ | `SG4 DTM+92`, `YYYYMMDD` |
| `transaktionsgrund` | ✓ | `SG4 STS+7` — a code the column admits, else `TRANSAKTIONSGRUND_UNZULAESSIG` |
| `bilanzkreis` | config | `SG10 CCI+Z19`; else the single `standard` `[[lf.bilanzkreise]]` entry |
| `abrechnungsintervall_monate` | ✓ | `SG6 DTM+Z20` |
| `haushaltskunde` | ✓ | `SG10 CCI+++Z15`/`Z18` |
| `netznutzungsvertrag`, `netznutzung_zahler` | ✓ | `CCI+++Z88` `CAV+Z74`/`CAV+Z73` |
| `gemeinderabatt_prozent` | ✓ | `SG8 SEQ+Z12 QTY+Z16` |
| `kunde` | ✓ | `SG12 NAD+Z09`, `NAD+Z04` |
| `ablesekarte` | ✓ | `SG12 NAD+Z05` |

Every missing fact is named in one `422` `ANMELDEDATEN_UNVOLLSTAENDIG`
(`fehlend`), every malformed one in `ANMELDEDATEN_UNGUELTIG`
(`maengel`). There is no Gas equivalent of API-Webdienste Strom — the
ERP must supply the Gas-MaLo-ID upfront.

## Mindestvorlauffrist

**10 Werktage** for a Lieferantenwechsel (`E03`, AWH GeLi Gas 2.0 Kap.
2.5.2 SD „Lieferbeginn" Nr. 1), enforced here. For an Einzug the NB
corrects the date instead of rejecting, so those pass with a
`vorlauffrist_hinweis`.

EndSupplyGasRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/end-supply-gas` — GeLi Gas Lieferende (44004).

The fields `makod`'s `geli.lieferende.anmelden` reads
(`mako_markt::commands::GeliLieferendeAnmelden`): the Marktlokation, the
`YYYYMMDD` `process_date` and the Transaktionsgrund the 44004 column makes
Muss (`SG4 STS+7`, UTILMD AHB Gas 1.2 Kap. 5.5).

transaktionsgrund.description: `SG4 STS+7` DE 9013 — makod holds it against the column's codes.

`SG4 STS+7` DE 9013 — Muss on the Abmeldung 55004 (UTILMD AHB Strom
2.2 Kap. 5.4); makod holds it against the column's codes. The
Lokationsart Ergänzung is the MaLo's own, which makod reads.

note.description: `SG25 FTX+ACB` — the field reference the LF sees.

pruefschritt_code.description:
`SG15 STS DE9013` — the EBD Prüfschritt code for the "erfolgreich"
cluster. The AHB makes it a **Muss**, so an IFTSTA built without one is
invalid; it is optional here only because an operator-created order has
no market correspondent to send an IFTSTA to.

external_ref.description:
The executing system's own reference: 1–200 characters, opaque, unique
per tenant.

endgueltig.description:
`true` when no further Sperrversuch will be made — a court injunction, a
glaubhaft gemachter Verhinderungsgrund (Kap. 3.5.1.2 Nr. 5), or simply the
field team calling it off.

Defaults to `false`: GPKE Teil 2 Kap. 3.5.1.2 Nr. 5 gives the NB **two**
Sperrversuche within one Sperrauftrag, so an ordinary "nobody home"
report records the attempt and leaves the order in the queue. The second
failure closes it regardless of this flag.

pruefschritt_code.description:
`SG15 STS DE9013` — the EBD Prüfschritt code from the "gescheitert"
cluster (`A04`/`A05`/`A06` under EBD E_0472 for a Sperrung).

reason.description: `SG25 FTX+ACB` — why it could not be carried out.

oneOf.description:
Whom the visit is put down to: `customer`, `contractor`, `operator` or
`nobody`. Kept on the order and in its events; the Lieferant asks why.
